groups.title: See, hear and understand
groups.intro: Give your agent the photo, screen or audio context it needs.
groups.alt: A phone sends a kitchen photo to an agent on a laptop.

features.title: Camera snapshots
features.description: Request a front- or rear-camera photo with the camera feature enabled.
features.example: Show your agent what is on the workbench.

features.title: Screenshots on request
features.description: After you enable the screenshot service and feature, an agent can request a visible, logged capture.
features.example: Ask your agent to explain an error currently on screen.

features.title: Your latest image
features.description: Retrieve the latest photo or screenshot, or wait for the next one you take.
features.example: Take a screenshot of an error and ask what it means.

features.title: Photo access
features.description: Let an agent list and retrieve images within the gallery access you grant.
features.example: Find a receipt photo to include in your expenses.

features.title: Short audio recordings
features.description: Capture an audio clip of up to two minutes for an authorized agent.
features.example: Record a voice note for your agent to summarize.

features.title: Videos and downloads
features.description: Access supported video files or still frames, and files you select from Downloads.
features.example: Pull a still frame from a video for your agent to inspect.

features.title: Short video recordings
features.description: Capture a short front- or rear-camera video, with optional audio.
features.example: Show a repair specialist how a mechanism moves.

features.title: On-device text recognition
features.description: Extract text from a selected image on the phone before sending the result.
features.example: Read a serial number without sending the whole photo.

features.title: On-device transcription
features.description: Turn a microphone clip into text on the phone.
features.example: Dictate a short note for your agent.

groups.title: Work with your agent
groups.intro: Answer a question, follow progress, hear a reminder or exchange a file.
groups.alt: A person answers an agent’s question on a phone.

features.title: Questions and notices
features.description: Agents can send messages with buttons, choices or a text reply.
features.example: Answer “Which draft should I use?” from your phone.

features.title: Interactive cards
features.description: View an agent-created HTML card with charts or forms in an isolated view without network access.
features.example: Compare three options and send your choice back.

features.title: Live text
features.description: Read text as an agent streams it to a panel on your phone.
features.example: Follow a coding agent’s progress while away from your desk.

features.title: Audio playback and speech
features.description: Play an agent-supplied audio clip or read text aloud within your sound settings.
features.example: Hear “Time to leave” from your reminder agent.

features.title: Open a link or app
features.description: Agents can present a link or app shortcut; you tap to open it.
features.example: Open the map your agent prepared for you.

features.title: A shared inbox
features.description: Bring questions, notices, files and shares into one history.
features.example: Look up an earlier question and your reply.

features.title: Receive files
features.description: Receive documents, images and other supported files from an agent.
features.example: Send a finished PDF from your agent to your phone.

features.title: Share with an agent
features.description: Use Android sharing to send selected photos, links or text to an agent.
features.example: Share a restaurant link with a note about your plans.

features.title: Copy text with approval
features.description: Put agent-provided text on the clipboard after you approve it.
features.example: Copy a prepared address to paste into another app.

features.title: Events and callbacks
features.description: Integrations can receive events such as answers, new images or feature changes.
features.example: Let your agent continue when you answer a question.

groups.title: Add real-world context
groups.intro: Use selected device information to make an agent’s help more relevant.
groups.alt: A phone shares a location with a connected agent.

features.title: Location on request
features.description: Share a location fix, accuracy and age when location access is enabled.
features.example: Ask your agent for directions from where you are.

features.title: Phone context
features.description: Expose selected battery, network, screen, sound and activity information.
features.example: Check whether the phone is charging before a long task.

features.title: Sensor readings
features.description: Request supported light, pressure, motion, orientation or step readings.
features.example: Use a light reading as context for a device workflow.

features.title: App usage summaries
features.description: Read permitted summaries of app usage and screen time.
features.example: Review where your phone time went this week.

features.title: Health Connect summaries
features.description: Read the health records you explicitly allow through Health Connect.
features.example: Bring permitted steps or sleep data into a personal check-in.

features.title: Notification summaries
features.description: Read notification text only after you enable notification access.
features.example: Summarize the notifications that arrived during a meeting.

features.title: A guided city walk
features.description: Combine location, heading and chosen photos with an agent’s commentary.
features.example: Explore a neighborhood with an architecture guide.

features.title: Location history and places
features.description: Explore optional local location history and place-based triggers.
features.example: Ask for a reminder when you get home.

groups.title: Put the phone to work
groups.intro: Use deliberate device controls and approved screen-access sessions.
groups.alt: An agent helps adjust phone settings.

features.title: Flashlight
features.description: Turn the torch on for a bounded period, then switch it off automatically.
features.example: Light the workbench for a photo.

features.title: Sound and display
features.description: Adjust supported sound, Do Not Disturb and brightness settings with timed restoration.
features.example: Silence the phone for a meeting, then restore its settings.

features.title: Find your phone
features.description: Request a ring and vibration, subject to Android’s sound restrictions.
features.example: Locate the phone you left under a cushion.

features.title: Alternative screen access
features.description: Use an owner-approved screen-sharing grant as an alternative capture method.
features.example: Grant screen access for a troubleshooting session.

groups.title: Connect and build
groups.intro: Use the documented API or MCP with compatible agents and integrations.
groups.alt: A person connects an agent to their phone.

features.sourceTitle: Add an agent in a minute
features.title: Connect your agent
features.description: Pair a compatible agent with a setup prompt and its own connection details.
features.example: Connect the agent you already use on your laptop.

features.title: Separate agent keys
features.description: Give each agent a key you can rotate or revoke independently.
features.example: Remove one agent without disconnecting the others.

features.title: Discoverable API
features.description: A live guide describes the API, enabled capabilities and possible errors.
features.example: Let a new integration discover how to use the phone.

features.title: API change notices
features.description: Agents can discover API revisions and read what changed.
features.example: Help an integration pick up a newly added capability.

features.title: MCP tools
features.description: Connect an MCP-capable agent to enabled device tools using its own key.
features.example: Ask your connected coding agent for a desk photo.

features.title: Hosted-agent connection
features.description: Explore a relay for compatible agents that cannot join your private network.
features.example: Connect a hosted assistant without a direct Tailscale connection.

groups.title: Keep control
groups.intro: Choose access, review activity, pause agents and maintain the app.
groups.alt: A person manages which device features their agent can use.

features.title: Feature switches
features.description: Choose enabled features and Android permissions, and pause the listener.
features.example: Turn camera and microphone access off before a meeting.

features.title: Quick pause
features.description: Pause or resume the connection from an Android Quick Settings tile.
features.example: Disconnect agents from the notification shade.

features.title: Private-network connection
features.description: Direct access requires your Tailscale network and an agent key.
features.example: Connect an agent on your computer to your own phone.

features.title: Permissions per agent
features.description: Choose different capability grants for different agents.
features.example: Give a photo organizer gallery access without camera access.

features.title: Activity history
features.description: Review device requests, results and feature changes in the activity log.
features.example: See which agent requested a photo and when.

features.title: Agent notes
features.description: Agents can leave short notes alongside device activity.
features.example: Keep a note of what a workshop check found.

features.sourceTitle: Report a bug or ask for a feature
features.title: Bug reports and feedback
features.description: Send a report with the context you choose; follow its status and confirm a fix.
features.example: Report a failed capture with the relevant activity attached.

features.title: App updates
features.description: Check for an app update and confirm installation through Android.
features.example: Install a fix when you are ready.

groups.title: Explore what comes next
groups.intro: Two directions under consideration, with no availability promise.
groups.alt: A concept illustration of a person speaking a trigger phrase to a phone.

features.sourceTitle: Listen for a word on the phone
features.title: Local trigger words
features.description: Explore on-device word detection for explicitly enabled voice workflows.
features.example: Say a chosen phrase to begin a voice note.

features.title: Messages, contacts and calendar
features.description: Explore communications access and owner-approved actions.
features.example: Approve a prepared “I’m running late” message.
